arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ نَزَغَـاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ وَكَيْدِهِ وَمَكَائِدِهِ، وَمِنَ الثِّقَةِ بِأَمَـانِيِّهِ وَمَوَاعِيدِهِ وَغُرُورِهِ وَمَصَائِدِهِ، وَأَنْ يُطْمِعَ نَفْسَهُ فِي إضْلاَلِنَا
transliteration: allāhumma innā naʿūdhu bika min nazaghati ash-shaytani ar-rajimi wa kaydihi wa maka'idih wa mina alththiqati bi'amanihi wa mawa'idih wa ghururihi wa masa'idih wa-an yuṭmiʿa nafsahu fī iḍlālinā
english_text: O God, we seek refuge in Thee from the instigations of the accursed Satan, his trickery, and his traps, from trust in his false hopes, his promises, his delusions, and his snares, and lest he should make himself crave to lead us away

arabic_text: عَنْ طَاعَتِكَ وَامْتِهَانِنَا بِمَعْصِيَتِكَ، أَوْ أَنْ يَحْسُنَ عِنْدَنَا مَا حَسَّنَ لَنَا، أَوْ أَنْ يَثْقُلَ عَلَيْنَا مَا كَرَّهَ إلَيْنَا.
transliteration: ʿan ṭāʿatika wa-amtihāninā bimaʿṣiyatika aw ʾan yahsun ʿindanā mā ḥassana lanā aw an yathqula ʿalayna ma karrh ilayna
english_text: from Thy obedience and to degrade us through our disobeying Thee, and lest what he has shown us as beautiful be beautiful for us and what he has shown us as detestable weigh down upon us.

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اخْسَأْهُ عَنَّا بِعِبَادَتِكَ، وَاكْبِتْهُ بِدُؤوبِنَا فِي مَحَبَّتِكَ، وَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُ سِتْراً لاَ يَهْتِكُهُ، وَرَدْماً مُصْمِتاً لا يَفْتُقُهُ.
transliteration: allāhumma akhsaʾhu ʿannā bi ʿibādataka wa akbit-hu biduʾūbinā fī maḥabbatika waajʿal baynana wa baynahu sitran la yaḥtikuhu waradmā musmitan lā yafthuquhu
english_text: O God, drive him away from us through Thy worship, throw him down through our perseverance in Thy love, and place between him and us a covering that he cannot tear away and a solid barrier that he cannot cut through!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَـلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ، وَاشْغَلْهُ عَنَّا بِبَعْضِ أَعْدَائِكَ، وَاعْصِمْنَا مِنْهُ بِحُسْنِ رِعَايَتِكَ، وَاكْفِنَا خَتْرَهُ، وَوَلِّنَا ظَهْرَهُ، وَاقْطَعْ عَنَّا إثْرَهُ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih waashghalhu 'annaa biba'đi 'a'daa'ika waʿṣimnā minhu biḥusni riʿāyatika, wākfinā khatrah wa wallinā ẓahrahū, waqṭaʿ ʿannā iṯrahū
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, distract Satan from us with some of Thy enemies, preserve us from him through Thy good guarding, spare us his treachery, turn his back toward us, and cut off from us his trace!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَمْتِعْنَا مِنَ الْهُدَى، بِمِثْلِ ضَلاَلَتِهِ، وَزَوِّدْنَا مِنَ التَّقْوَى ضِدَّ غَوَايَتِهِ، وَاسْلُكْ بِنَـا مِنَ التُّقى خِـلافَ سَبِيلِهِ مِنَ الـرَّدى.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa-amtiʿna min al-hudā, bimithli ḍalālatihi. wa zawwiddnā mina al-taqwá ḍidda ghawāyatihi wasluk binā mina al-taqwá khilāfa sabīlihi mina al-raddā
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, give us to enjoy guidance the like of his misguidance, increase us in piety against his seduction, and make us walk in reverential fear contrary to his path of ruin!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجْعَلْ لَهُ فِي قُلُوبِنَا مَدْخَلاً وَلاَ تُوطِنَنَّ لَهُ فِيمَا لَدَيْنَا مَنْزِلاً.
transliteration: allāhumma lā tajʿal lahū fī qulūbinā madkhalan walā tuṭinnan lahu fīmā ladaynā manzilan
english_text: O God, assign him no place of entrance into our hearts and do not allow him to make his home in that which is with us!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ وَمَا سَوَّلَ لَنَا مِنْ بَاطِل فَعَرِّفْنَاهُ وَإذَا عَرَّفْتَنَاهُ فَقِنَاهُ، وَبَصِّرْنَا مَا نُكَايِدُهُ بِهِ، وَأَلْهِمْنَا مَا نُعِدُّهُ لَهُ، وَأَيْقِظْنَا عَنْ سِنَةِ الْغَفْلَةِ بِالرُّكُونِ إلَيْهِ وَأَحْسِنْ بِتَوْفِيقِكَ عَوْنَنَا عَلَيْهِ.
transliteration: allāhumma wamā sawwala lanā min bāṭil faʿarrisnāhu wa-iżā ʿarraftanāhu faqināhu, wa-baṣṣirnā mā nukāyiduhu bih wa alhimnā mā nuʿidduhu lahū, wa ayyiqznā ʿan sinati al-ghaflati bi'r-rukuuni ilayhi wa aḥsin bi tawfīqika ʿawnanā ʿalayh
english_text: O God, cause us to recognize the falsehood with which he tempts us, and once Thou hast caused us to recognize it, protect us from it! Make us see what will allow us to outwit him, inspire us with all that we can make ready for him, awaken us from the heedless slumber of relying upon him, and help us well, through Thy giving success, against him!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ وَأَشْرِبْ قُلُوبَنَـا إنْكَارَ عَمَلِهِ، وَالْـطُفْ لَنَا فِي نَقضِ حِيَلِهِ.
transliteration: allāhumma wa ashrib qulūbanā inkāra ʿamalih wa al-ṭuf lanā fī naqḍi ḥīlih
english_text: O God, saturate our hearts with the rejection of his works and be gentle to us by destroying his stratagems!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَحَوِّلْ سُلْطَانَهُ عَنَّا، وَاقْطَعْ رَجَاءَهُ مِنَّا ، وادْرَأْه عَنِ الْوُلُوعِ بِنَا.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammadi wa ālihi wa ḥawwil sultānahu ʿannā waqtʿ rajāʾahu minnā, wa adraʾhu ʿani al-wulūʿ bi nnā
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, turn his authority away from us, cut off his hope from us, and keep him from craving for us!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْ آباءَنَا وَأُمَّهَاتِنَا وَأَوْلاَدَنَا وَأَهَالِينَا وَذَوِي أَرْحَامِنَا وَقَرَابَاتِنَا وَجِيْرَانَنَا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَـاتِ مِنْهُ فِي حِرْز حَـارِز،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālihī wa'j'al aaba'ana wa umma'hatina wa awlaadana wa ahaleena wa dhawi arḥāminā wa qarābātinā wa jīrānā min al-muʾminīn wa al-muʾmināt minhu fī ḥirz ḥāriz
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, and place our fathers, our mothers, our children, our wives, our siblings, our relatives, and the faithful among our neighbours, male and female, in a sanctuary impregnable to him,

arabic_text: وَحِصْن حَافِظ ، وَكَهْف مَانِع، وَألْبِسْهُمْ مِنْهُ جُنَناً وَاقِيَةً، وَأَعْطِهِمْ عَلَيْهِ أَسْلِحَةً مَاضِيَةً
transliteration: wa-ḥiṣn ḥāfiẓ, wa-kahf māniʿ, wa-albis-hum minhu junanā waqiyatan wa'ațihim ʿalayhi asliḥatan māḍiyatan
english_text: a guarding fortress, a defending cave! Clothe them in shields protective against him and give them arms that will cut him down!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَاعْمُمْ بِذلِكَ مَنْ شَهِدَ لَكَ بِالرُّبُوبِيَّةِ، وَأَخْلَصَ لَكَ بِالْوَحْدَانِيَّةِ، وَعَادَاهُ لَكَ بِحَقِيقَةِ الْعُبُودِيَّة، وَاسْتَظْهَرَ بِكَ عَلَيْهِ فِي مَعْرِفَةِ الْعُلُومِ الرَّبَّانِيَّةِ.
transliteration: allāhumma wāʿimm bi dhālika man shahida laka bir-rubūbiyya wa-akhlasa laka bil-wahdāniyyati wa ʿādāhu laka bi-ḥaqīqati al-ʿubūdiyyah wa astaẓhar bi-ka ʿalayhi fī maʿrifat al-ʿulūm al-rrabbāniyyah
english_text: O God, include in that everyone who witnesses to Thee as Lord, devotes himself sincerely to Thy Unity, shows enmity toward him through the reality of servanthood, and seeks help from Thee against him through knowledge of the divine sciences!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ احْلُلْ مَا عَقَدَ، وَافْتقْ مَا رَتَقَ، وَافسَخ مَا دَبَّرَ، وَثَبِّطْهُ إذَا عَزَمَ، وَانْقُضْ مَا أَبْرَمَ.
transliteration: allāhumma ahlul mā ʿaqada, wa aftiqh mā rataqa wāfisakh mā dabbara, wa thabbithhu idhā ʿazama, wa anquḍ mā ʾabrama
english_text: O God, undo what he ties, unstitch what he sews up, dislocate what he devises, frustrate him when he makes up his mind, and destroy what he establishes!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ وَاهْزِمْ جُنْدَهُ وَأَبْطِلْ كَيْدَهُ وَاهْدِمْ كَهْفَهُ وَأَرْغِمْ أَنْفَهُ.
transliteration: allahumma wahzim jundahu wa'abtil kaydahu waahdim kahfahu wa'arghim anfahu
english_text: O God, rout his troops, nullify his trickery, make his cave collapse, and rub his nose in the ground!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنَا فِي نَظْم أَعْدَآئِهِ وَاعْزِلْنَا عَنْ عِدَادِ أَوْلِيَائِهِ، لا نُطِيعُ لَهُ إذَا اسْتَهْوَانَا، وَلا نَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُ إذَا دَعَانَا
transliteration: allāhumma ijʿalnā fī naẓm aʿdāʾihi waʿzilnā ʿan ʿidādi awliyāʾihi lā nuṭīʿu lahu ʾiḏā istahwānā wa lā nastajību lahu idhā daʿānā
english_text: O God, place us in the ranks of his enemies and remove us from the number of his friends, that we obey him not when he entices us and answer him not when he calls to us!

arabic_text: نَأْمُرُ بِمُنَاوَاتِهِ مَنْ أَطَاعَ أَمْرَنَا وَنَعِظُ عَنْ مُتَابَعَتِهِ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ زَجْرَنَا.
transliteration: na'muru bimunāwātihim man 'aṭā'a amranā wa naʿiẓu ʿan mutābaʿatihi mani ittabaʿa zajranā
english_text: We command everyone who obeys our command to be his enemy and we admonish everyone who follows our prohibition not to follow him!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَسَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَعَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الـطَّاهِرِينَ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad khātimin-nabiyyīn wa sayyidil-mursalīn wa ʿalā ʾahl baytihi al-ṭayyibīna al-ṭāhirīna
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad the Seal of the prophets and lord of the emissaries, and the folk of his house, the good, the pure!

arabic_text: وَأَعِذْنَا وَأَهَـالِينَا وَإخْـوَانَنَا وَجَمِيـعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ مِمَّا اسْتَعَذْنَا مِنْهُ، وَأَجِرْنَا مِمَّا اسْتَجَرْنَا بِكَ مِنْ خَوْفِهِ
transliteration: wa'a'ithna wa'ahalina wa'ikhwananā wa jamīʿa al-muʾminīna wa al-muʾmināti mimmā istaʿaḏnā minhu wa ajirna mimma astajarna bika min khawfihi
english_text: Give refuge to us, our families, our brothers, and all the faithful, male and female, from that from which we seek refuge, and grant us sanctuary from that through fear of which we seek sanctuary in Thee!

arabic_text: وَاسْمَعْ لَنَا مَا دَعَوْنَا بِهِ وَأَعْطِنَا مَا أَغْفَلْنَاهُ وَاحْفَظْ لَنَا مَا نَسِيْنَاهُ،
transliteration: wasmaʿ lana mā daʿawnā bihī waʾaʿṭinā mā aghfalnāhu waḥfiẓ lana mā nasīnā
english_text: Hear our supplication to Thee, bestow upon us that of which we have been heedless, and safeguard for us what we have forgotten!

arabic_text: وَصَيِّرْنَا بِذَلِكَ فِي دَرَجَاتِ الصَّالِحِينَ وَمَـرَاتِبِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: waṣayyirnā bi dhālika fī darajāt al-ṣāliḥīn wa marātib al-muʾminīn
english_text: Through all this bring us into the ranks of the righteous and the degrees of the faithful!

arabic_text: آمينَ رَبَّ ا لْعَالَمِينَ .
transliteration: ʾāmīn rabbi al-ʿālamīn
english_text: Amen, Lord of the worlds!
